vista.name: TLS 1.1/1.2 support update for Windows Server 2008 SP2 - NOT for Vista (KB4019276, 32-bit)
vista.name_pl: Obsługa TLS 1.1/1.2 dla Windows Server 2008 SP2 - NIE dla Visty (KB4019276, 32-bit)
vista.signer: CN=Microsoft Corporation, OU=AOC, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US
vista.notes: Official Microsoft package, but Microsoft documents it ONLY for Windows Server 2008 SP2 (catalog titles: 'Update for Windows Server 2008 (KB4019276)' / '... for x64-based Systems'; Microsoft Security blog 2017-07-20 'TLS 1.2 support added to Windows Server 2008'; no Vista entry exists in the catalog). Microsoft Learn 'Solving the TLS 1.0 Problem' (updated 2026-03-26) lists Windows Vista as TLS 1.1 'Not Supported' / TLS 1.2 'Not Supported' and says 'a Vista client will fail to negotiate TLS with a server configured for TLS 1.2+ as Vista's maximum supported TLS version is 1.0. That client should be either upgraded or decommissioned'; Server 2008 is 'Disabled*' (enabled via this optional package). The KB4019276 support article itself now returns HTTP 404 (retired), so its registry instructions could not be re-read today. The catalog has three revisions (07/2017, 09/2017, 11/2017); this is the 11/2017 file. DECISION: do NOT apply on Vista by default. Installing a Server 2008 package on Vista is outside Microsoft support; it would not require changing the edition/SKU (Vista and Server 2008 SP2 share build 6002), but Charon must never spoof the SKU or use ESU/licence workarounds to make it install; whether wusa accepts it unmodified on Vista is UNVERIFIED. Modern browsers in this manifest (Supermium, Mypal) bring their own TLS stack, so OS TLS 1.2 is not needed for browsing. Kept for reference/hash only. read 2026-11-25

vista.name: QEMU sound card for Vista guests

vista.notes: Use QEMU '-device intel-hda -device hda-duplex' (or hda-output) for Vista. Microsoft Learn 'High Definition Audio DDI' (updated 2025-07-18): 'In Windows Vista, Microsoft will provide the following two drivers as part of the operating system: A bus driver for managing an Intel High Definition Audio (HD Audio) bus interface controller. A Universal Audio Architecture (UAA) class driver for managing a UAA-compliant audio codec' and 'In the absence of a custom audio driver from the vendor, users can rely on the system-supplied UAA HD Audio class driver'. AC97 (QEMU -device AC97, Intel 82801AA): no Microsoft statement of an in-box Vista driver was found; treat it as needing a vendor driver (Realtek AC'97 Vista driver, not in this manifest) - absence of an in-box driver is UNVERIFIED. No download. read 2026-11-25
